mapper.select: SELECT template_id, template_code, template_name, biz_type, content, paper_size, default_flag, status, deleted_flag FROM t_print_template WHERE template_code = #{templateCode} AND status = 1 AND deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY default_flag DESC, template_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: update t_print_template set default_flag = 0 WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND deleted_flag = 0
